events.name: Kennesaw State Owls at Middle Tennessee Blue Raiders

headlines.description: — Rickie Collins threw for 206 yards and three touchdowns, and Tywon Christopher returned an interception 59 yards for a score as Kennesaw State pulled away from Middle Tennessee 44-28 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Rickie Collins' 3 passing TDs help Kennesaw State beat Middle Tennessee 44-28 in Conference USA play
